title: Memoir: Learning, Verifying, and Evolving False-Positive Memories for Static Application Security Testing Tools
abstract: arXiv:2608.09181v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Static Application Security Testing (SAST) tools have become indispensable in modern secure software devel- opment. However, these tools often generate false-positive (FP) alerts, imposing substantial manual inspection costs and reducing the trust from developers. Existing FP reduction methods still face two primary challenges. First, the large differences among SAST tools and vulnerability categories make it difficult for these methods to learn recurring patterns in historical false positives. Moreover, the knowledge used by these methods are largely static and cannot be updated as newly validated cases accumulate. To address these challenges, we propose Memoir, a memory- driven framework for identifying false positives by transform- ing historical FP alerts into reusable semantic memories. translated_title: Memoir：为静态应用安全测试工具学习、验证与演化误报记忆
translated_abstract: 静态应用安全测试（SAST）工具已成为现代安全软件开发中不可或缺的组成部分。然而，这些工具经常产生误报（FP）警报，带来了大量的人工审查成本，并降低了开发人员的信任度。现有的误报消减方法仍面临两个主要挑战：其一，SAST工具与漏洞类别之间的巨大差异，使得这些方法难以从历史误报中学习重复出现的模式；其二，这些方法所使用的知识大多是静态的，无法随着新验证案例的积累而更新。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了Memoir，一个通过将历史误报警报转化为可复用的语义记忆来识别误报的记忆驱动框架。该框架包含两个关键模块：首先，历史语义记忆构建模块将历史误报警报转换为结构化的语义记忆……
tldr: 提出Memoir框架，通过将SAST工具的历史误报警报转化为可学习、可验证并持续演化的结构化语义记忆，有效识别并减少误报，克服了现有方法难以跨工具泛化、知识无法动态更新的局限。
en_tdlr: Memoir is a memory-driven framework that transforms historical false-positive alerts from SAST tools into reusable, verifiable, and continuously evolving semantic memories, effectively identifying false positives while overcoming the limitations of poor cross-tool generalization and static knowledge in existing approaches.
